verdict.rationale: The probe confirms CoreWeave hosts a live llms.txt at docs.coreweave.com/llms.txt returning HTTP 200 with structured agent-oriented content summarizing docs, and the broader docs corpus is written in clear markdown-accessible form suitable for agent consumption. missing for 10: no independent third-party corroboration of an agent actually consuming/using the llms.txt successfully, and no explicit documentation page describing llms.txt as an intentional agent-facing feature.
